URmessage, identity phase 1, slice 1
This is a test build of identity phase 1, slice 1.

WHAT IS NEW
One ID for your account. The first time it starts, URmessage sets up this computer:
  - "This is my first device" shows your recovery phrase, 25 words, once. Write them on paper.
  - Then type them back. A wrong word is named, and nothing is corrected for you.
  - Settings, then Account, shows "Your ID" (36 characters, with Copy) and this device, with its
    device ID and the mark that it holds your phrase's key.
These words cannot bring your account back yet. URmessage never stores them, and the screens that
show or take them are kept out of screenshots and screen sharing.

NOT IN THIS BUILD
Adding a second computer to your account, removing a device and changing the phrase come in later
builds. A conversation still starts with today's join code.

HOW TO RUN IT
1. Unzip this folder anywhere.
2. Put the credential file you were sent at %LOCALAPPDATA%\URmessage\dev\user1.jwt
3. Run URmessage.exe.

AN OLDER BUILD'S DATA
This build keeps its conversations in a new folder, %LOCALAPPDATA%\URmessage\live\identity-slice1,
and never reads what an older build kept. The older build's data stays where it was: the folders
"stream" and "state" in %LOCALAPPDATA%\URmessage\live. To delete it, close URmessage, then delete
those two folders. Do not delete identity-slice1.
